steps.en: Install it into your Python environment
Open the PDF and pick the page that holds your data
steps.zh: 打开 PDF，选出数据所在的那一页

steps.en: Parses the page via pdfminer.six into chars, lines and rects with coordinates
steps.zh: 借 pdfminer.six 把页面解析成带坐标的字符、线、矩形

steps.en: Crop to the table region if needed and ask for the table
steps.zh: 必要时裁到表格区域，然后要表格

steps.en: Finds drawn or text-implied lines, intersects them into cells, groups cells into a table
steps.zh: 找出画出的或文字暗示的线，求交成单元格，再归成表格

steps.en: Returns rows as lists of cell strings
steps.zh: 按行返回单元格字符串列表

value.en: Table rows come out of a machine-generated PDF as clean lists you can load into pandas
value.zh: 机器生成的 PDF 里的表格，变成能直接装进 pandas 的干净行列表
